summary: Frontend-only tests for Market bug fix (DIGITAL GM visibility, Todos tab, search, live sync, image sanitization, category regression). 7/8 scenarios pass. One spec deviation found: when an active category tab (e.g. 'Moda') is selected, typing a search term does NOT bypass the category filter, so items without 'categoria' do not re-appear via search as the spec requires ('vuelve a aparecer independientemente de la categoría activa').

ui_bugs.issue: Search does not override active category filter. Spec says: 'Al escribir "DIGITAL" en el buscador vuelve a aparecer independientemente de la categoría activa.' Repro: inject local item {nombre:'DIGITAL GM'} without `categoria`, click `market-cat-moda`, type 'DIGITAL' in `market-search-input` → list shows 'Sin resultados'. Expected: DIGITAL GM should appear. Current code (lines 89-102) applies `cat !== 'todos' && x.categoria !== cat` BEFORE the search check.

integration_issues.flow: Admin → Market end-to-end (crear DIGITAL GM solo con nombre)
integration_issues.issue: After clicking + Nuevo Comercio, filling nombre='DIGITAL GM' and Guardar in /admin → navigating to /market, DIGITAL GM NOT visible in Todos. Could not fully diagnose from UI alone; backend may silently reject missing categoria or Admin submit button selector matched a non-save button. Needs main agent to verify Admin.jsx submit path and whether addLocal fallback triggered.

passed_tests: Tab 'Todos' present as market-cat-todos and active by default
Search input data-testid='market-search-input' present and functional
Local item without categoria appears in Todos as market-shop-{id}
Local item without categoria does NOT appear in Moda tab (correct)
Image sanitization: no rendered when imagen missing (fallback Store icon shown)
'Oferta' chip renders when oferta_titulo is present
Live sync: dispatching CustomEvent('utrerapp:local-updated', {detail:{endpoint:'/comercios'}}) after adding to localStorage refreshes Market list without reload
Regression: Moda/Deportes tabs filter strictly by categoria === tab id (no cross-contamination)
Search works correctly when 'Todos' tab is active
action_items: Fix Market.jsx filter in `shops` useMemo so that when the user has typed a search query, the category filter is relaxed (or at least allows items without `categoria`). Suggested change: if `needle` is non-empty, skip the `cat !== 'todos' && x.categoria !== cat` early-return (match by search across ALL items), OR include items with missing categoria. Example: `if (cat !== 'todos' && x.categoria && x.categoria !== cat) return false; if (!needle) return cat === 'todos' || x.categoria === cat; ...` — exact behavior per spec: search bypasses category.
Verify Admin → Market end-to-end flow for DIGITAL GM creation (categoria vacía). Check Admin.jsx submit handler + API fallback to addLocal when categoria is omitted.
critical_code_review_comments: Market.jsx `shops` filter logic contradicts the spec stated in the review request: search should match regardless of active category.

Fallback image handler uses `e.currentTarget.style.display = 'none'` which hides a broken image but leaves the element in DOM — current implementation acceptable because safeImg() already prevents rendering empty src.

mergeWithLocal uses `{...byId.get(it.id), ...it}` which means for duplicate ids local overrides server (good), but if server item has `_local` undefined and local has true, label 'LOCAL' will appear even for items that exist on server — minor edge case.
seed_data_creation: Injected test items in localStorage['local_comercios'] during tests (test-digital-gm-1, test-live-sync-2, test-moda-1, test-dep-1, bug-check-1). Not persisted to backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Main bug to retest: typing a term in market-search-input while a non-'Todos' category is active should surface matching items that lack `categoria`. Current code at /app/frontend/src/pages/Market.jsx lines 89-102 blocks this. Also retest the Admin→Market E2E for an item created with empty categoria.
rca of the issue: In Market.jsx `shops` useMemo, the filter returns false for any item where categoria !== active tab (unless tab is 'todos'), BEFORE evaluating the search needle. Therefore a user who selected 'Moda' and types 'DIGITAL' can never see an item whose categoria is undefined/different. Spec requires search to override category filter. Fix: short-circuit the category check when `needle` is non-empty, or additionally allow items where x.categoria is falsy.
